morning_cleanser.name: Gentle Non-Stripping Cleanser
morning_cleanser.ingredient_or_category: Hydrating syndet bar or gentle amino-acid cleanser
morning_cleanser.purpose: Removes nocturnal sebum and perspiration without disrupting the epidermal stratum corneum lipid barrier.
morning_cleanser.limitations: Does not treat active inflammatory acne lesions on its own.
morning_cleanser.safety_notes: Avoid harsh sulfates and abrasive physical scrubs. Use lukewarm water.
morning_cleanser.source: American Academy of Dermatology (AAD) Barrier Guidelines, 2024

morning_antioxidant.name: Soothing Niacinamide or Azelaic Formulation
morning_antioxidant.purpose: Supports sebum regulation, diminishes visual blotchiness, and improves epidermal barrier resilience.
morning_antioxidant.limitations: Concentrations above 10% may cause contact dermatitis or flushing.
morning_antioxidant.safety_notes: Patch test on forearm before facial application. Discontinue if persistent stinging occurs.
morning_antioxidant.source: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology (JAAD) 2023; 88(3):612-620

morning_sunscreen.name: Broad-Spectrum Daily Photoprotection SPF 30-50+
morning_sunscreen.ingredient_or_category: Broad-Spectrum SPF 30-50+ with Zinc Oxide, Titanium Dioxide, or photostable organic filters
morning_sunscreen.purpose: Protects against UVA/UVB induced post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH) and oxidative collagen degradation.
morning_sunscreen.limitations: Requires reapplication every 2 hours under prolonged direct sun exposure.
morning_sunscreen.safety_notes: Essential for any skincare routine; prevents UV-aggravated erythema and dark marks.
morning_sunscreen.source: British Association of Dermatologists Photodermatology Guidelines, 2023

evening_cleanser.name: Double or Balanced Evening Cleansing
evening_cleanser.ingredient_or_category: Micellar water or gentle foaming gel cleanser
evening_cleanser.purpose: Thoroughly dislodges mineral sunscreen, micro-particulates, and daytime sebum accumulation.
evening_cleanser.limitations: Over-cleansing can precipitate reactive rebound sebum hypersecretion.
evening_cleanser.safety_notes: Gently pat dry with a clean cotton towel. Do not rub vigorously.
evening_cleanser.source: AAD Acne Patient Management Care Path, 2024

evening_active.name: Gentle Topical BHA or Encapsulated Retinoid
evening_active.purpose: Lipophilic beta-hydroxy acid penetrates follicular infundibulum to clear keratinaceous plugs and reduce microcomedone formation.
evening_active.limitations: Initial retinization purging or mild desquamation can occur during the first 2-4 weeks.
evening_active.safety_notes: Do not apply on broken, weeping skin or open lesions. Introduce gradually 2 nights per week.

evening_barrier.name: Ceramide-Rich Barrier Repair Cream
evening_barrier.ingredient_or_category: Ceramides (NP, AP, EOP), Hyaluronic Acid, and Cholesterol (3:1:1 ratio)
evening_barrier.purpose: Replenishes intercellular lipid matrix, accelerating recovery and reducing transepidermal water loss (TEWL).
evening_barrier.limitations: Provides restorative hydration; not a substitute for prescribed anti-inflammatory therapy.
evening_barrier.safety_notes: Non-comedogenic formulation suitable for acne-prone skin.

undereye_hydration.name: Caffeine & Peptide Periorbital Serum
undereye_hydration.purpose: Helps temporarily reduce periorbital puffiness and improve microcirculation in thin lower eyelid skin.
undereye_hydration.limitations: Does not alter structural infraorbital bone concavity or congenital venous pooling.
undereye_hydration.safety_notes: Avoid getting directly into the ocular surface. Dab gently using the ring finger.
